evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 1.3 ha, 280 m from the road.

plan: Drive: from Stuie, about 172 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.23108, -126.63538, pull off on Saghalie FSR (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 280 m NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1 m, about 6 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-14, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.
R5B-duck-drive-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 1-14: about 269 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.04 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.3 km and about 1 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).

R5B-grouse-atv-0002.name: By Seymour River
R5B-grouse-atv-0002.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R5B-grouse-atv-0002.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Saghalie FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
7 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: sooty (blue) and ruffed only; 5 each (15 each); no open season on Denman Island (page 20)
sooty (blue) and ruffed; Bow Only; 5 each (15 each); no bow only season on the Gulf Islands in MU 1-1 (except Gabriola Island), in zone B of MU 1-5 (Map A12) or on Denman and Hornby Islands (MU 1-6)
No row in the Region 1 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Mountain quail: printed 'No open season on mountain quail'.

plan: Drive: from Stuie, about 173 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.23066, -126.63543, where the truck road ends (Saghalie FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the Seymour FSR stretch, 4.5 km one way. About 89 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-14, Region 1. Season: grouse Sept 1 to Dec 31 and more rows (synopsis page 21, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.
